community.evidence: All Berkshire shares will be left to foundations

shareholders.evidence: to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: First-person, owner-directed letter from Buffett and Munger, addressing shareholders as partners first. Tone is aspirational yet candid, with hedged commitments ('we hope', 'we will try'). Shareholder value and candor dominate; customers, employees, environment and safety are absent. Distinctive framing: shareholders as 'owner-partners' and 'eggs-in-one-basket' alignment.
